# print-queue-client

A typed client for the routes of module `com.github.aux.vertigo235.prusa-connect-print-queue`, generated from the
module's own OpenAPI fragment. It adds nothing to the wire: every call goes
through a `@prusa/connect` client's transport, under `/api/v1/modules/com.github.aux.vertigo235.prusa-connect-print-queue/`.

## Using it

```ts
import { PrusaConnect, ApiError } from "@prusa/connect";
import { bind } from "print-queue-client";

const local = new PrusaConnect({ url: "https://printers.local:8080", auth: "pcl_..." });
const module = bind(local);

try {
  // One method per operation in the fragment, named after its operationId.
  await module.someOperation({ path: { id: "x" } });
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof ApiError) console.log(err.status, err.code);
}
```

`bind` takes anything with a `transport`, and a `PrusaConnect` is one. The
methods it returns take the same request object and `AbortSignal` as the
core's, and they send the client's credential.

## Errors and events

A module's fragment carries no error registry, no event types and no
authorization vocabulary, so this package ships none. A refused call throws
the core's `ApiError`, and `err.code` is the module's own code as a string,
outside the union the core package names. Events the module publishes are
read with the core client's `events()`, by type.

The peer range on `@prusa/connect` is `0.1.0`, the version of the core this
package was generated against. The core package's version is the server's,
so a consumer installs the one its server runs.
